predeclared_hypothesis.baseline_deficiency: The unchanged regularized outcome-prior models do not expose whether historical result-versus-score residuals, close-game residuals, margin volatility, or downside-tail frequency contain incremental chronological signal.
predeclared_hypothesis.candidate_change: Add eight immutable home-minus-away sustainability and downside-risk contrasts to the unchanged baseline logit or margin prediction, with explicit cold starts and fit-only imputation.
predeclared_hypothesis.expected_direction: Incremental value, if present, should reduce probability or margin error in both the 2024 and 2025 rolling-origin seasons without a sign reversal across metrics; mixed or negative evidence rejects adoption.
predeclared_hypothesis.adoption_rule: No promotion in this work unit. Preserve identical-row effect sizes; prefer the unchanged reference unless improvement is stable, material, and later replicated on genuinely untouched evidence.
predeclared_hypothesis.threshold_policy: No post-hoc threshold and no fabricated materiality cutoff.

limitations: All artifacts, metrics, and decisions are PRELIMINARY_UNPROTECTED_EXPOSURE_AWARE.
The 2024-2025 outcomes have already supplied development feedback and cannot be presented as untouched protected evidence.
The profiles summarize static 2010-2022 retrospective evidence known in May 2023 and are not target-season updates.
The 2023 candidate is an exact frozen-baseline fallback; 2024 fits only 2023 outcomes and 2025 fits only 2023-2024 outcomes.
Outcome-only residuals are descriptive candidates and do not identify causal luck, clutch performance, coaching effects, injuries, turnovers, or field position.
The recent window includes the 2020 pandemic regime; its composition is diagnostic-only and is not silently normalized.
Negative or mixed evidence is preserved and cannot promote a champion, A&M adjustment, BAS, or Aggie Excess.
